changes: Made for the mouse: Every menu gets a full pass with the mouse.
Tidier on triple screens: Notices now appear on the centre screen instead of far left, and the header band runs across all three screens, also behind the track photos.
Small wishes: Choose the season length when you start a career.
Qualifying and your grid slot: The game only uses qualifying for the grid when at least half the field has set a valid lap.
Track book says where a record was set: Every record now shows whether it was set in a race or in qualifying, and when.
Career path labels: On the career path two labels above the first step could overlap.
Licences page opens at your level: With a medal in every test of your licence, the Licences page could open at the Pro level.
Start lights after pausing: After opening the pause menu in a licence test, the start lights could stay on screen without lighting up.
